input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap is one-way: it protects TrueLink alone (Client's liability, including under its broad Section 12(a) indemnity, is unlimited) and it applies only to Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 rather than the whole agreement. There is no USD floor, no mutual exclusion of consequential damages, no carve-out for confidentiality/data-security or indemnification, and no confirmation that Client's payment obligations sit outside the cap. We made the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 with the standard Excluded Claims.

input.quote: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any
input.rationale: TrueLink's indemnity is limited to its own breach or failure to perform and contains no third-party IP-infringement indemnity for the Interface or Hosting Services, no breach-of-law, data-breach or misconduct coverage — while Client's indemnity in 12(a) is very broad (including claims "without regard to any knowledge limitation"). We added the standard Vendor indemnity limbs; the asymmetry with 12(a) should also be revisited.
